summary: Scene-file node parser. Allocates and constructs a 572-byte scene graph node, attaches it to a parent (a3), then consumes a token stream (a4) one line at a time, matching keyword strings against the node's mesh/animation/LOD/collision/shadow/render/visibility properties and setting bit flags and float/view fields. On stream end it links the node into the scene graph (doubly-linked or actor-list append) and optionally applies orientation/view data; on parse failure it frees the node.

local_names.this: scene graph container being appended into
local_names.a2: source file/context string for mesh path copy
local_names.v31: alias of the scene node base
local_names.v4: current mesh or animation list node being configured
local_names.v47: scratch string buffer for boolean keywords
local_names.v48: scratch string buffer for instance/mesh/anim names
local_names.v49: scratch string buffer for response data

operations.description: Prologue: atomically decrement the audio-buffer reference counter dword_8B8EE8 via InterlockedDecrement, then run AudioVolumeLoadComputation(0).
Allocate a 572-byte node with OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper; if non-null construct it through sub_54A600, otherwise leave it null.
Initialize the node: v6[15] = 0 (state field), v6[16] = a3 (parent pointer); zero local float/int scratch v42/v45/v44/v39/v41/v43, and prime v40/v38 with -1.0.
If a parent (a3) is present, set the node's state field v6[15] to 8.
Read the first line via LineReaderFromBuffer(a4); if it returns 1 the stream is exhausted and parsing jumps straight to the finish path (LABEL_122).
Finish path: walk the child-node chain rooted at v6[129], writing v6[20] into each child's +252 slot and advancing via the +16 next pointer until the chain ends.
Finish path link: if a parent (a3) exists insert the node with DoublyLinkedListNodeMover(a3, v6, 0), otherwise append with ActorNodeLinkedListAppend(this, v6).
Finish path fallback: when the node has no children, register it with SceneGraph(v6), run TwoFunctionCallChain(), then free it with FreeWrapper_7bcf(v6).
Finish path orientation: if the view-orientation flag v37 is set, apply the parsed view data via sub_54B4D0(v6, v43, v41, v39, v44, v45, v42).
Return 0 on the normal finish path.
Main token loop: if *a4 == 3 jump to finish; if *a4 == 2 jump to the line re-read (LABEL_120); if sub_559F00 matches the aVisgroups keyword into v46, break to the visgroup continuation.
aInstance keyword: match with sub_559E20; if a nested scene node definition follows, recurse as SceneNode(v48, v8, a4) and return -1 on failure.
aMeshfile keyword: copy the mesh path via SelfCopyStringWithValidation(v8, a2, v48) (return -1 on failure), then walk the mesh list at v8+516 to its tail, tracking the last node in v4.
aAnimfile keyword: resolve the animation name through sub_5518A0(this, &v34, v48, 0) (return -1 on failure); read the aAutostart keyword and compare to aTrue to set the v36 autostart flag.

Animation list walk at v31+516: scan nodes with sub_551560; when autostart (v36) is set, remove the matching animation entry with LinkedListStringKeyRemoval(v4, v34 + 28); return -1 if a matching node is found.
Animation registration: add the animation to the node via UIListNodeManager(v31, v34) (return -1 on failure); if autostart, flag the audio handle at v31+532 with AudioFlagSet.
aLodin keyword: parse a LOD-in distance with PRNG4UniformFloatsFromSeed(a4, aLodin, &v40, 0, 0, 0); on success apply it via ConditionalFloatFieldSetter(v4, v40, -1.0).
aLodout keyword: parse a LOD-out distance with PRNG4UniformFloatsFromSeed(a4, aLodout, &v38, 0, 0, 0); on success apply it via ConditionalFloatFieldSetter(v4, -1.0, v38).
aHattarget keyword: set or clear bit 0x100 in the current node's +20 flag dword depending on whether the value equals aTrue.
aColltarget keyword: set or clear bit 0x40 in the current node's +20 flag dword depending on aTrue.
aSpheretarget keyword: set or clear bit 0x80 in the current node's +20 flag dword depending on aTrue.
aZbuffer keyword: clear or set bit 0x2000 in the current node's +20 flag dword depending on aTrue (inverted: true clears it).
aShadowcaster keyword: if true and not already handled (v35), insert the current node with LinkedListNodeInsert_5930(this, v4, a3) (return -1 on failure) and set the v35 guard.
aShadowobject keyword: if true and not already handled (v35), insert with LinkedListNodeInsert_5930(this, v4, a3) (return -1 on failure), OR bit 0x2000000 into the +20 flags, and set the v35 guard.
aShadowreceiver keyword: on true OR bit 0x4000 into the +20 flags and increment the container's shadow-receiver count this[79]; on false clear bit 0x4000.
aReflector keyword: on true OR bit 0x20000 into the +20 flags and increment the container's reflector count this[93]; on false clear bit 0x20000.
aMorphtarget keyword: if true, OR bit 0x200000 into the current node's +20 flags.
aLightobject keyword: read the token value into v47 with sub_559E20; the parsed value is not used further.
View orientation (vtable): parse three floats through PRNG4UniformFloatsFromSeed(a4, &off_5DC230, &v43, &v41, &v39, 0); on success set the v37 flag.
aOrient keyword: parse three floats through PRNG4UniformFloatsFromSeed(a4, aOrient, &v44, &v45, &v42, 0); on success set the v37 flag.
aMoveable keyword: set or clear bit 0x10 in the scene node's +60 flags depending on aTrue.
aStamp keyword: on true OR bits 0x100|0x10 into the scene node's +60 flags; on false clear bit 0x100.
aBillboard keyword: on true OR bits 0x2000|0x10 into the scene node's +60 flags; on false clear bit 0x2000.
aRender keyword: on true clear bit 4 of the scene node's +60 flags; on false set bit 4.
aChange keyword: on true clear bit 0x200 of the scene node's +60 flags; on false set bit 0x200.
aSpecial1 keyword: parse an int with sub_559F00 into v33, then apply it with RenderFlagSetter(v31, v33, 2048).
aSpecial2 keyword: parse an int with sub_559F00 into v33, then apply it with RenderFlagSetter(v31, v33, 4096).
aPlanes keyword: parse an int with sub_559F00 into v33 and store it at scene node +80.
aActor keyword: copy the actor name into v47 and register it via sub_559820(v31, v47, 0).
aHatactor keyword: copy the hat-actor name into v47 and register it via sub_559820(v31, v47, 1).
aResponse keyword: copy the response name into v47 and its payload into v49, then dispatch via sub_5598B0(v31, v47, v49).
LABEL_120 (a4 == 2 path): re-read the next line with LineReaderFromBuffer(a4); if it returns 1 jump to the finish path.
Visgroup continuation after aVisgroups match: if (v46 & dword_8B8EE0) == v46, store the mask at scene node +56 and resume the token loop; otherwise skip the remaining lines.
Visgroup rejection path: drain lines until *a4 == 3 or LineReaderFromBuffer returns 1, then run TwoFunctionCallChain() and free the scene node with FreeWrapper_7bcf(v31); return 0.

clean_pseudocode: if (match(visgroups, &mask)) { if ((mask & dword_8B8EE0) == mask) { node[56] = mask; continue; } drain(); cleanup(); return 0; }
if (match(instance, s) && SceneNode(s, node, buf) == -1) return -1;
if (match(meshfile, s)) { if (copyString(node, a2, s) == -1) return -1; v4 = tail(node[516]); }
for (c = node[129]; c; c = c[4]) c[63] = node[20];
if (parent) DoublyLinkedListNodeMover(parent, node, 0); else ActorNodeLinkedListAppend(this, node);
if (viewFlag) sub_54B4D0(node, z, y, x, yaw, pitch, roll);
